examples.reply:
```flowproof
workflow analyze_topic
  needs topic: text
  role analyst can answer
  budget at most 4 calls

  let count = ask analyst: """
    How many independent sub-questions does this topic have?
    Topic: {topic}
    Answer with a number only.
    """ as number

  fork 3 into answers
    let answer = ask analyst: """
      Answer this topic:
      {topic}
      It has {count} independent sub-questions.
      """
    keep answer
  end

  give answers
end
```

```flowproof
workflow analyze_topic
  needs topic: text
  role analyst can answer
  budget at most 4 calls

  let subquestions = ask analyst: "How many independent sub-questions does this topic have? Reply with a number only. Topic: {topic}" as number

  fork 3 into answers
    let answer = ask analyst: "Answer this topic independently. It has {subquestions} independent sub-questions: {topic}"
    keep answer
  end

  give answers
end
```
